name: Estadísticas de Orden Superior
description: Analiza kurtosis and skewness of gradiente distribucións. Natural images have heavy-tailed distribucións while AI images tend toward Gaussian.
algorithm: Gradient Domain Kurtosis and Skewness Analysis
mechanism: Computes first-order gradiente differences and analiza their higher-order estadístico moments. AI images show more Gaussian-like distribucións.
useCase: Detecting Gaussian-like gradiente statistics in generado por IA images

references.title: Lyu, S. & Farid, H. (2006). Steganalysis Using Higher-Order Image Statistics. IEEE TIFS.
Farid, H. (2009). Image Forgery Detection. IEEE Signal Processing Magazine.
Mendel, J.M. (1991). Tutorial on Higher-Order Statistics. Proceedings of the IEEE.

strengths:
• Captures non-Gaussian properties invisible to basic statistics
• Skewness and kurtosis reveal AI distribución anomalías
• Fast computation on pixel distribucións
• Format-independent análisis
• Strong theoretical foundation in estadístico signal processing
limitations:
• Lower standalone discrimination power
• Sensitive to image content type (sky vs complex scene)
• Post-processing can normalize distribucións
• Requires sufficient image size for stable statistics
• Some AI models produce natural-looking distribucións
